A central box labelled **Evidences of Evolution** has an arrow running from it to each of four boxes. Two of those boxes carry printed text and two are left blank:

| Position of box | Printed inside the box |
|---|---|
| Top left | Morphological |
| Top right | (blank) |
| Bottom left | Similarities in bones structure |
| Bottom right | (blank) |
